source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of thermohaline circulation (PDF 182-183).

blocks.text: Thermohaline circulation ('thermo' yani garmi, 'haline' yani namak), jise aksar global conveyor belt kehte hain, zameen ke samandaron ka aik bohat aham amal hai jo garmi ko tropical (garam) ilaqon se poles tak le jata hai. Yeh gardish pani ke temperature aur salinity ke farq se chalti hai, jo mil kar samandar ke pani ki density tay karte hain. Equator ke qareeb garam aur kam dense pani surface ke saath polar ilaqon ki taraf jata hai aur apne saath garmi (heat energy) le jata hai. Polar ilaqon mein yeh pani thanda ho jata hai, aur sea ice banne se is ki salinity barh jati hai; dono wajah se yeh dense ho kar doob jata hai aur gehrai mein equator ki taraf wapas behta hai. Yeh musalsal harkat zameen ka climate qaboo mein rakhti hai, hawa ke patterns par asar dalti hai, aur garmi aur nutrients (ghizai ajza) duniya bhar mein phaila kar samandari ecosystems ko sahara deti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit! (Dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Thermohaline circulation, yani 'Global Conveyor Belt', ko duniya ke gird aik poora chakkar lagane mein taqreeban 1,000 saal lagte hain. Agar global warming ise sust kar de to Europe ko chhote barfani daur (mini ice age) ka samna ho sakta hai, jab ke baqi duniya garam ho rahi ho.

blocks.prompt: Thanda, namkeen pani kyun doob kar gehri current banata hai, aur yeh thermohaline circulation mein samandar ke pani ki asal harkat se kaise jura hai?
blocks.explanation: Thanda aur namkeen pani aas paas ke pani se zyada dense hai, is liye gravity use neeche le jati hai. Doobta hua pani gehrai mein samandar ki tah ke saath equator ki taraf dhakela jata hai. Poles par yahi doobna woh 'pump' hai jo conveyor belt ki gehri, wapas aane wali shaakh chalata hai; garam surface ka pani us ki jagah lene poles ki taraf aata hai.

blocks.text: Fig. 21.15 mein garam surface currents (surkh pattiyan) poles ki taraf behti hain, jahan thandak aur barf banne se un ki density barhti hai aur woh doob jati hain (neeli pattiyan). Yeh thanda, dense pani samandar ki tah ke saath phailta hai aur aakhir kaar doosre ilaqon mein phir oopar aata hai. Is global conveyor belt ki mukammal teen-dimensional gardish ko duniya ke tamam samandari basins se pani guzarne mein taqreeban 1,000 saal lagte hain. Yeh garmi aur nutrients poori zameen par phaila kar climate qaboo mein rakhne mein aham kirdar ada karti hai.

blocks.alt: Duniya ka naqsha aur global conveyor belt: surkh pattiyan (warm shallow current) Pacific aur Indian Ocean se, junoobi Africa ke gird aur Atlantic mein shimal ki taraf door shimal tak; neeli pattiyan (cold deep current) Atlantic mein junoob, Southern Ocean mein mashriq, phir Indian aur Pacific mein shimal ki taraf. Legend: Warm shallow current, Cold deep current.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.15: thermohaline gardish dikhati gehre samandar ki gardish (kitab ki Figure 21.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Surkh (garam) pani surface par poles ki taraf jata hai. North Atlantic jaise thande ilaqon mein woh thanda aur barf banne se namkeen ho kar bhari ho jata hai aur doob jata hai; yahi neeli (thandi, gehri) current ban kar Southern Ocean se Indian aur Pacific tak jati aur wahan aahista oopar uthti hai. Poora chakkar taqreeban 1,000 saal leta hai.

items: Thermohaline circulation: temperature aur salinity (density) se chalti hai.
Garam surface pani poles ki taraf; wahan thanda aur namkeen ho kar doobta aur gehrai mein wapas; aik chakkar taqreeban 1,000 saal.
Garmi tropics se polar ilaqon tak jati hai.
